title: Sharp focal radius estimate and rigidity of hypersurfaces in manifolds with positive curvature
summary: We prove a sharp Clifford-threshold focal-radius estimate and rigidity for immersed hypersurfaces. Under a $p$-form curvature condition, formulated by the Weitzenböck curvature term together with $\mathrm{Ric}_p\ge p$, any closed two-sided immersion $F:Σ^m\to M^{m+1}$ with $b_p(Σ;\mathbb R)\neq0$ and $1\le p\le m/2$ satisfies \[ r_f(F,M)\le\fracπ{4}. \] The equality case is rigid: if the ambient manifold is complete, equality forces the hypersurface to be locally the Clifford hypersurface $S^p(1/\sqrt2)\times S^{m-p}(1/\sqrt2)\subset S^{m+1}(1)$; if the ambient manifold is compact and…
